title: Making a decision visible
subtitle: A rich document with supporting evidence

context.summary: Demonstrate rich text, code and evidence in one saved artifact.

body.content:
# A small decision, with its reasoning

A report needs room for **evidence**, *uncertainty*, and a [source](https://example.com/research). A chart alone leaves too much of that in the conversation.

## The question

Can we increase the number of completed reviews without making each review longer?

> Keep the measurement and the explanation together.

### Working assumptions

- The same reviewers take part in each period.
- Each review has the same acceptance criteria.
  - Incomplete reviews do not count.
  - Reopened reviews are tracked separately.

### Review sequence

1. Collect a matching baseline.
2. Change one part of the process.
3. Compare completed reviews and time spent.

~~Raw throughput is enough.~~ Compare accepted outcomes.

---

## A calculation you can inspect

```ts
function acceptedPerHour(accepted: number, hours: number) {
  return accepted / hours;
}
```

| Period | Accepted reviews | Hours |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Baseline | 42 | 14 |
| Revised | 54 | 15 |

The result is **promising**, with a small sample. An improvement from 3 to 3.6 accepted reviews per hour is an observation, not a forecast.

- [x] Preserve the inputs.
- [x] Record the assumptions.
- [ ] Repeat with a matched period.

Special characters remain readable: café, coöperation, &, <sample>.

body.title: Decision
body.content: Keep the revised process for another matched period. **Revisit the decision** if acceptance quality changes.
